class_id: an optional 'any one non-space character' slot before a printed number (meant for a currency glyph) swallows the number's own leading digit whenever the glyph is not printed
feature: scraper/scripts/extract_filing.py extract_price_band_ad: the PRICE BAND and FACE VALUE regexes, which every PRICE_BAND_AD read (text or OCR) passes through; and any future reader that writes `\S?\s*(\d...)` to absorb a rupee glyph
symptom: A regex of the shape `\S?\s*([\d,]+)` lets `\S?` match the first DIGIT when no glyph precedes the number (an OCR page routinely drops the rupee sign), so '172.00 TO 182.00' reads 72 / 82 and a face value of '10' reads 0. The result is a well-formed number that passes type and range checks; when the two ends lose different digits the band check REFUSES it instead, and a REFUSED read clears a stored value (OD-160). Any such slot must exclude digits: `(?:[^\s\d]\s*)?`.
first_seen: 2026-10-03 - IPODhan, measured on the stored page text (document_pages) of all 76 PRICE_BAND_AD documents on ipodhan_staging (docs/design/probes/item39-pba-texts.mjs), read by the real extract_filing.run before and after the fix: 18 of 76 read differently. 16 had been REFUSED (adroit-industries 26/34 for 126/134; ashutosh-fibre, elevate-campuses, hero-motors x2, lumino-industries x2, nityas-gems, sonaselection, ss-retail, tempsens-instruments, varmora-granito, veegaland x2, vishal-nirmiti), glass-wall-systems read 72/82 for the printed 172/182 (stored on staging, F-231, #1477), and 2 face values of 10 read as missing/0 (veegaland, hero-motors). After the fix every VALUE band equals the stored band except glass-wall, whose stored 72/82 is the wrong one. omara-ventures stays REFUSED for a different reason (unexamined).
fix_prs: PR #1483 (item 39 round 2): `_GLYPH_SLOT` excludes digits in extract_price_band_ad; plus ocr_pages.guard_price_band_lost_digit (round 2, review MAJOR-1/2): an OCR band or face value whose leading digit the advert's own other mentions contradict - lost digit (72 for 172) or the rupee glyph read as an extra digit (7172 for Rs 172, 72 for Rs 2) - and an OCR band its own ordering check refused, become MISSED with the cause and an ambiguous_token, never REFUSED, so the re-read clear keeps a stored band. Evidence excludes P/E, EPS, times and market-cap lines, non-integer amounts and a single glyph-shaped (2/7/8) extra lead. On the 76 staging adverts in their recorded read mode, zero band ends would clear. EXTRACTOR_VERSION @2026-10-04 re-opens PRICE_BAND_AD.
